subject: Device operator commands: work status and work reset-crashes
fix(companion): reject overlong daemon sockets before spawn
Provider events checked on their own terms; crash backoff waits; crashes reset
body:
A Sonnet 5.5 turn on Django stopped when the Hub refused a whole-file tool result:
provider events went through grant JSON rules (64 KiB strings, 256 items). They
now allow strings and arrays up to the event bound, still refusing NUL, bad
numbers and deep nesting. On the device, an active crash backoff is waited out
instead of ending the loop, and a completed turn resets the crash count.

subject: Companion GitHub publication: fixes from the delivery-pipeline audit
body:
- git apply --whitespace=nowarn: CRLF files, trailing-space Markdown and blank
  lines at EOF no longer fail after acceptance (tree equality still proved)
- The base branch may move on: base_sha must be an ancestor of its tip (compare
  API); diverged or force-pushed bases are refused; the commit stays on base_sha
- Publication is bound to the Hub's patch_sha256 (exact diff.patch bytes) before
  any build or GitHub call; an authority without it is an error
- Every publication bound refusal names
